subject: Before the trial, the team agreed a workload allocation ceiling of 100 requests per minute.
rationale: K08-S supports only the general use of agreed policy thresholds; it does not establish this team's pretrial agreement or the specific ceiling of 100 requests per minute. K08-T states those details but is cited only as CONTEXT, which cannot establish substantive support. The exact descriptive assertion therefore lacks role-appropriate warrant; this does not establish that it is false.
